stumbles.why: Jev and the register.md entry are never explained; a reader can't tell what is being compared (a model? a lint tool?).

point: The commit adds metrics.json and analyze.py so RESULTS.md's numbers are traceable, and the headline finding is that Jev with the register.md entry (AUROC 0.808) cannot be statistically distinguished from a category-prior baseline (0.769).
